instructions: Closed book. For each item: read the stem only and write your solution in stem_only before you read the options. Then choose the answer labels. Use no sources. Set flag to one sentence when you see a second defensible answer or a missing constraint, else null.

items.stem: A company runs an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance that is encrypted with the AWS managed key aws/rds. RDS takes a daily automated snapshot of the DB instance. A new audit requires that a separate backup account in the same AWS Region receives one copy of the most recent automated snapshot. The backup account must be able to restore the copy. Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Edit the key policy of the aws/rds key so that the backup account can use the key to decrypt the snapshot.

options.label: B
options.text: Share the manual snapshot copy with the backup account, so that the backup account can copy the snapshot and restore from it.

options.label: C
options.text: Export the database with a dump tool from an Amazon EC2 instance, and upload the dump file to the backup account.

options.label: D
options.text: Share the automated snapshot with the backup account directly, so that the backup account can copy it.

options.label: E
options.text: Copy the automated snapshot to a manual snapshot under a customer managed key, and allow the backup account to use the key.
